SampleRequest.name: SampleRequest
SampleRequest.description: Represents a request for product samples, including customer account details, request date and status. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

Account.description: The sample request to which the product is associated.

Contact.description: The sample request to which the product is associated.

SalesRepresentative.description: The sample request to which the product is associated.

SampleRequest.description: The sample request to which the product is associated.

SampleItemReference.description: Indicates the specific sample product which can be either a standard product or a custom product requirement.

Product.description: ID of the standard sample product requested in the sample request.

ProductRequirementSpecification.description: The unique product specification required for the sample, if not a standard product.

ProductCategory.description: The category of the sample product being requested.

Purpose.description: The reason for requesting this particular product or sample.

Quantity.description: The quantity of the product or sample requested.

UnitOfMeasure.description: The unit of measure for the requested sample.

BatchNumber.description: The specific product batch associated with the requested sample product.

SalesPrice.description: The sales price of the sample product.

CostPrice.description: The cost of the sample product.

AdditionalInfo.description: The additional details or special instructions for the sample product.

PriceBookEntry.description: The price book entry defining the sample product's price.

CostBookEntry.description: The cost book entry defining the sample product's cost.

ListPrice.description: Price of a product as specified in a price book.
